intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Strong, stable, and made to stay
features.text: Crafted from engineered wood, our frame offers long-lasting support with a polished, contemporary finish that fits beautifully into your home.

features.title: A headboard with presence and comfort
features.text: The wide rectangular headboard offers a clean, modern look while giving you the perfect backrest for reading, relaxing or morning lounging.

features.title: Storage that keeps life effortlessly tidy
features.text: With underbed compartments designed for everyday organisation, you can keep spare bedding, clothes, or bits and bobs neatly tucked away — and always within easy reach. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: A warm, natural look that feels like home
features.text: Our cinnamon woodgrain laminate brings an earthy richness to your room — creating a cosy, inviting atmosphere you’ll love coming back to.

features.title: Protected to handle real life
features.text: A tough PU coating helps shield your bed from scuffs, scratches and daily wear — so it stays looking lovely, no matter how busy life gets.

name: Upmods Eudora Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
